name: mh-retirement-contribution-reference
description: Selected 2017 amended statutory reference for ordinary Marshall Islands Retirement Fund contributions, using fictional complete calendar quarters for one independently established worker and employer. Illustrates the source's quarterly covered-earnings ceiling and separate worker and employer shares where percentage products are already exact cents. Explains the defective consolidation, Board-adjustment qualification and source limits. Keeps actual coverage, contribution rounding, deductions, remittances, Health Fund, income tax and operational delivery held. Use for source review and conditional arithmetic examples, not current payroll or a complete social contributions engagement. Tier 2 draft awaiting qualified review.
